findings.title: Webhook branch name reaches a shell command
findings.trace: The branch parameter is concatenated into a shell command.
findings.boundary: An authenticated repository webhook supplies the branch name.
findings.validation:
Static review traced the branch parameter to sh -c. The following candidate input was not executed.

```text filename=input.txt
main; printf example
```
findings.rating: The webhook value can inject commands into the deployment worker.
